$comment: Advisories knowingly accepted, each with a reason and an expiry. An expired entry FAILS the build on purpose: an exception you never revisit is just a hole you stopped looking at. Remove an entry the moment the underlying fix lands.

exceptions.advisory: DeepmergeTS stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs
exceptions.reason: Reached only via prisma -> @prisma/config, the migration CLI, which runs at build time and merges our own prisma.config file. No request path touches it, so there is no attacker-supplied input to exhaust the stack with. The patched deepmerge-ts 8.x arrives only with Prisma 7, a major upgrade we are not doing days before launch; an npm `overrides` pin is silently ignored at a workspace root (npm 11.6). Scheduled with the Prisma 7 upgrade after launch.
Transitive carrier of the deepmerge-ts advisory above; same reasoning, same fix, same date.
Transitive carrier of the deepmerge-ts advisory above. devDependency: the CLI, not the runtime client. @prisma/client is unaffected.
